statement: The Matrix 1S 3IN1 is a 40 mm cross, its ESC sockets sit 12.3 mm out on the side arms' undersides, and its grommets are 2.6 mm tall and 4.6 mm across
rationale: BetaFPV publishes the 25.5 mm mounting pattern, the 1 mm board and the weight; the outline, socket positions and grommets are scaled from its photos against the 7 mm MCU. Measure the board when it arrives (P4).
